name: jev-router
description: Routes each prompt to the cheapest capable subagent with a fully local JEV-style engine, and blocks token-heavy tool calls. No API key; nothing leaves your machine.

read_line_cap.title: Read guard line cap
read_line_cap.description: Deny (once) a full Read of files longer than this many lines

ctx_warn_tokens.title: Context size warning
ctx_warn_tokens.description: Warn when a session's context passes this many tokens (it is re-sent with every prompt), then every further 50k; 0 disables

holdout_percent.title: Holdout sessions (%)
holdout_percent.description: Share of sessions that get no hints, so savings and quality can be measured fairly; 0 disables

trim_output_lines.title: Bash output trim threshold
trim_output_lines.description: Trim Bash output longer than this many lines to head+tail; 0 disables
